গণপ্রজাতন্ত্রী বাংলাদেশ সরকার
জাতীয় রাজস্ব বোর্ড
ঢাকা ।

আদেশ

National Board of Revenue: The National Board of Revenue is the government entity issuing this formal administrative order in Dhaka.

Customs Act 1969: Section 21(b) of the Customs Act 1969 provides the legal authority for the National Board of Revenue to issue notifications for amendments to customs procedures and tariffs.
National Board of Revenue: The National Board of Revenue exercises its legal power to amend previously issued customs notifications concerning specific tariff codes.
H.S. Code: The H.S. Code entries listed in the Table of the specified notification are updated to reflect corrected or new commodity classification codes.
Specific codes are replaced to maintain the accuracy of the tariff schedule for customs processing.
Table: The Table contains the original H.S. Codes that are subject to technical amendments and formal replacement under this notification.
